findings.text: The rewritten sentence names the small-turn third-party hit-rate record as the source of the 278,174 input tokens but keeps the h 0.93 and 'our own 0.975' rates and the about-1.07x total from the other stratum: the small-turn record's own hit rate is 0.858 (h 0.8581679), while 0.93 is the production-size record's h (0.929855). The arithmetic is correct at the stated h -- input-term ratio 1.9910 and total ratio 1.0712 at h 0.93 over 278,174 in / 40,000 out -- but no single record carries 278,174 input tokens at h 0.93, so the illustrated period is a mix of two measured strata and cannot be checked against one record. At the small-turn h 0.858 the same tokens give a total ratio of 1.1848, not 1.07. The label 'assumed' on the output count is honest; the stratum pairing is what remains unstated. Residual of the node's own goal (every claim checkable), not a new defect introduced by this commit.
